faults.title: Clutch judder
faults.description: Clutch judder is a reported first-generation i10 problem, for which Hyundai has had a fix. Check how the car moves off from rest and have persistent shudder inspected.

faults.title: Headlight-aim switch failure
faults.description: The switch used to adjust headlight height on a Mk1 i10 can fail or buzz. Test the adjustment and have the switch checked if it makes noise or does not change the beam aim.
